desc:
A fast-paced co-op office-survival roguelike.
Will you make it through the chaos, or become overwhelmed?
You're expected to fail. Learn from it and return stronger.

☰ [DISCLAIMER]
This game contains Flashing Lights, Loud Noises, and Jumpscares!
This game is not made to be a horror game, but it might spook you from time to time!

☰ [DEVICES]
PC, Mobile and Console fully supported.
VR is not actively supported, but it is playable.

☰ [CREDITS]
One More Night is a Five Nights at Freddy's styled ROGUELIKE.
Five nights at Freddy's created by Scott Cawthon.
All Characters belong to their respective creators.
Toolbox Assets were used and belong to their respective creators.
Not a fully original idea, but with our own twist.

Music used belong to their respective creators.
DOORS by LSPLASH
Deepwoken by Vows by the Sea
Nullscape by Nullscape Team

☰ [ABOUT US]
